feeds.title: The Visual Music Village Blog
feeds.description: The Visual Music Village is the global network for our community, where you can add images and information to your profile, upload your videos or embed them from YouTube and Google video, and add events to the calendar: your screenings, performances, or any events you hear of that you think the community should know about: festivals, competitions, exhibitions, etc, post your news to the blog, announce your new work, DVD releases, and more!

feeds.title: Music Data Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tomás González, Music Data Blog is my personal website, where I work on design, communication, and music. I listen to records on a daily basis and also I do extensive research on rock and pop artists and bands. This website is where I tell stories about music in a visual way.

feeds.title: Expanded Animation » Visual Music
feeds.description: Know about all the visual music and all parts of synaesthetic syntax and more on Expanded Animation. This blog seeks to deterritorialize preconceived ideas about what animation is. For me, animation is the most vital and exciting art form of the 21st century: an intermedial melting-pot of many histories, approaches, disciplines, and styles; a place where profound questions are raised about truth and illusion, life and death.

feeds.title: VisualMusic.blogspot.com
feeds.description: The Visual Music blog by Maura McDonnell gathers resources of interest in the art of visual music. The blog in particular includes websites that document work, artists, filmmakers, composers, musicians, video artists, exhibitions, calls for worlds, and events that work with the art and medium of visual and sound. All forms and presentations of visual music and audiovisual composition and performance are considered.

feeds.title: GESO » Visual Music
feeds.description: Information about visual music including, music videos, live visuals, and music visualizations. Geso is a visual artist, illustrator, art director, and graphic designer, always looking for daring and challenging projects to be involved in, from art direction and graphic design to music videos, opening titles, creative visual content, live shows, stage design, interactive installations, VR projects, spherical images, dome projections, etc.
